commit 92ee10d5ba0fe89a9b48ce0be3a7f7f55c00d363 Author: Martin von Gagern Date: Tue Jun 30 11:54:35 2020 +0100 Restore attribute handling with empty block_id Commit 08c3e4f48b2cf137f1848e789d6b5d21075b4e65 had been aiming to be a semantic no-op in its attribute handling. But I had missed the fact that with empty block_id any characters between '@' and ' ' would cause the match to fail. This can be important e.g. when there are JavaDoc comments in code as these are likely to start with "{@". The sequence "{@ " can be used to introduce an extended comment inside a code block. I'm not sure whether that's a bug or a feature, so I'm documenting it in the test case for now, so that any change in behavior there will at least be deliberate. --- src/document.c | 9 ++++----- test/Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.html | 19 +++++++++++++++++++ test/Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.text | 17 +++++++++++++++++ test/config.json | 5 +++++ 4 files changed, 45 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-) diff --git a/src/document.c b/src/document.c index ca9fc07..79b24e1 100644 --- a/src/document.c +++ b/src/document.c @@ -697,13 +697,12 @@ static size_t parse_attributes(uint8_t *data, size_t size, struct hoedown_buffer } /* it might have matched only the first portion of block_id; make sure * there's no more to it here */ - if (*block_id || (begin < end && data[begin] != ' ')) { + if (*block_id) { return len; } - } else { - while (begin < end && data[begin] != ' ') { - begin++; - } + } + if (begin < end && data[begin] != ' ') { + return len; } if (block_attr) { if (block_attr->size) { diff --git a/test/Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.html b/test/Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.html new file mode 100644 index 0000000..25566e9 --- /dev/null +++ b/test/Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.html @@ -0,0 +1,19 @@ +

This is a space-indented code block.

+ +
{
+  /** JavaDoc with a {@link #somewhere}
+   */
+}
+
+ +

The link is not an extended attribute!

+ +
{
+  /** Code with attribute
+   */
+}
+
+ +

The above is an extended attribute, at least for now. +See #62 for a discussion about +whether this kind of syntax should be supported.

diff --git a/test/Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.text b/test/Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.text new file mode 100644 index 0000000..23cfde6 --- /dev/null +++ b/test/Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.text @@ -0,0 +1,17 @@ +This is a space-indented code block. + + { + /** JavaDoc with a {@link #somewhere} + */ + } + +The link is *not* an extended attribute! + + { + /** Code with attribute + */ + } {@ .codesample } + +The above *is* an extended attribute, at least for now. +See [#62](https://github.com/kjdev/hoextdown/issues/62) for a discussion about +whether this kind of syntax should be supported. diff --git a/test/config.json b/test/config.json index 5643817..28e3acd 100644 --- a/test/config.json +++ b/test/config.json @@ -166,6 +166,11 @@ "output": "Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_FencedCode.html", "flags": ["--special-attribute", "--fenced-code"] }, + { + "input": "Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.text", + "output": "Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_CodeBlock.html", + "flags": ["--special-attribute"] + }, { "input": "Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_Codespan.text", "output": "Tests/extras/Special_Attribute_Codespan.html",
